title: Dianne Penn (Anthropic's first technical PM, Head of Product for AI Research and Labs) recommends Incorruptible on Lenny's Podcast
summary: Dianne Penn — Anthropic's first technical PM, now Head of Product for AI Research and Labs — closes her Lenny's Podcast appearance by naming Incorruptible as one of just three recommended books, alongside Crucial Conversations and How to Raise an Adult. Lenny Rachitsky's 200K-subscriber product podcast; Anthropic's own governance is a case study in the book.
blockquote: Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad... and How Great Companies Stay Great
blockquote_source: Dianne Penn on Lenny's Podcast (Recommended Books)
